flag-icons (country-flag pack)
==============================

Vendored asset: none in this tree. The recipe at `../tools/` builds the pack
                from a checksummed tarball; the pack is published to the
                delivery plane and is not committed.
Owners:         Panayiotis Lipiridis (upstream artwork); TaffyGo decides the
                shipped set, which is exactly ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (decision 0047)
Licence:        MIT (vendor/flag-icons.MIT.txt, next to this file), carried
                verbatim as the pack's own LICENSE member so a device that has
                the flags has the notice beside them
Source:         https://registry.npmjs.org/flag-icons/-/flag-icons-7.5.0.tgz
Licence source: package/LICENSE inside that tarball
Downloaded:     2026-08-23, sha256
                c0b80bf0e08006a60f56621d6bc49f8c7131f4d1fef6737a165a673431f4b518

version=7.5.0
pack_sha256=46d06699bd17d6943eeb2d4540b707eae34c6313ac01d1835c61201b2decb5b5
pack_bytes=584892

The shipped set is the 249 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes in
`../tools/iso-country-codes.tsv`. flag-icons also ships England, Scotland,
Wales, Northern Ireland, Catalonia, Galicia, the Basque Country, Kosovo, the
European Union, the United Nations and six other entities; none of them is an
ISO 3166-1 entry and none of them is in the pack. Decision 0047 is why.

The pack is one zip of 250 members (249 `flags/<iso>.webp` plus LICENSE),
192×144 lossless WebP, the 4x3 set, built by `../tools/build_flag_pack.py`
through librsvg 2.58.0, cairo 1.18.0 and cwebp 1.3.2. Those three versions are
part of the bytes and are refused on mismatch.

Permitted use:  the identifying flag of a country the product can already name,
                on screens SCR-001, SCR-006 and SCR-407, beside that country's
                own name. A national flag is not a trademark.

Removal trigger: the corpus leaves this file the moment decision 0047 is
                 superseded, the moment the tarball's licence changes, or the
                 moment a flag is drawn for an entity that is not an ISO 3166-1
                 alpha-2 entry.
